dossier.purpose: Cognee is an Apache-2.0 Python library, CLI, FastAPI server, MCP server and Next.js UI that stores agent memory as a knowledge graph plus vector index plus relational metadata, via remember/recall/improve/forget (README.md:42,180-185). Defaults are embedded local stores (SQLite, LanceDB, Ladybug graph, SQLite session cache) with per-user/dataset ACL isolation on; an optional keyless mode uses local GLiNER and fastembed. The Claude Code and Codex plugins the README advertises live in a separate repo (topoteretes/cognee-integrations), not in this checkout; the in-repo route for both agents is the cognee-mcp server (examples/demos/company_brain/multi_source/README.md:159-215).

claims.claim: Free open-source AI memory platform; persistent agent memory as a self-hosted knowledge graph.
Runs locally for free, no API key required; uses small CPU models.
With no LLM key: local GLiNER graph extraction and local embeddings (download on first use); ingestion, retrieval and session storage work without an LLM; LLM-dependent improve stages skip.
The bundled GLiNER extractor is a demo; a production version is offered on request.
With a key set, OpenAI is used for LLM and embeddings and processing makes provider calls.
Agents retain project context, decisions, fixes and learned rules; session lessons are distilled into durable knowledge another session can retrieve.
remember stores permanently, or in a session when a session ID is given; recall retrieves; improve bridges session knowledge into the graph; forget removes an item or dataset.

Claude Code plugin: claude plugin marketplace add topoteretes/cognee-integrations; claude plugin install cognee-memory@cognee. Codex plugin: enable hooks, codex plugin marketplace add ... --ref main, codex plugin add cognee@cognee. Setup guide covers local or remote memory.
Other interfaces: OpenClaw plugin, MCP clients via cognee-mcp, Python API, TypeScript SDK, Rust, REST API.
cognee-cli -ui starts a local UI; needs Node.js/npm, and Docker for its MCP service.
docker run cognee/cognee:main with ENABLE_BACKEND_ACCESS_CONTROL=false is the single-user posture; otherwise multi-tenant and every /api/v1 call needs authentication.
Whole memory layer can run on one Postgres, released as a demo; production version is a licensed product.
Memory can be imported from Mem0, Letta, Zep, Graphiti via the COGX format.

docker run --rm -it -p 8000:8000 -e LLM_API_KEY="sk-..." -e ENABLE_BACKEND_ACCESS_CONTROL=false -v cognee_storage:/cognee-storage cognee/cognee:main

platforms.wsl2: unknown - no WSL/WSL2 statement in README, docs or CI; the only WSL mention is a Windows test-helper comment (cognee-mcp/tests/test_entrypoint_args.py:32-35).
platforms.macos_arm64: yes - CI includes macos-15 on Python 3.13 (test_suites.yml:205-211; runner arch not declared in the file); arm64 wheels exist for ladybug 0.19.0 (macosx_15_0, uv.lock:4834), ladybug 0.17.1 for macOS 13/14 (uv.lock:4808) and enola-cli (uv.lock:2809). macOS 13/14 are pinned to ladybug 0.17.x and stay exposed to storage-corruption defects (pyproject.toml:80-98). platforms.gpu: no - not required; CPU is the documented default (README.md:44-45); embeddings run on onnxruntime/fastembed (pyproject.toml:68-76); no cognee code selects a GPU device. The optional gliner extra installs PyPI torch, the CUDA build on Linux (pyproject.toml:242-248).

integrations.mcp: yes - separate package cognee-mcp 0.5.6 (cognee-mcp/pyproject.toml:3,99-101), FastMCP, transports stdio/http/sse (cognee-mcp/src/server.py:982-1008); advertises remember/recall/forget, cognify_status found via search_tools, improve not exposed (cognee-mcp/README.md:503-521,562-572). integrations.sdk_or_api: yes - async Python SDK (cognee/__init__.py:18-119); FastAPI REST under /api/v1 incl. remember, recall, improve, forget, sessions, datasets, permissions, agents, integrations (cognee/api/client.py:362-476). integrations.claude_code_or_codex: README documents a Claude Code plugin and a Codex plugin (hooks must be enabled) (README.md:191-218), but plugin code is in topoteretes/cognee-integrations, not in this checkout (catalog/entries/integrations/claude-code.yaml:22-24; codex.yaml:22-24), so capture/deletion behavior could not be inspected. readme.telemetry_and_network: TELEMETRY (default on; README does not mention it): send_telemetry() POSTs JSON via aiohttp to https://test.prometh.ai, a Vercel-hosted analytics proxy (cognee/shared/utils.py:20-21,283-294,364-449; 5 s timeout, fire-and-forget). Disabled by any non-empty TELEMETRY_DISABLED or ENV=test|dev (utils.py:400-405; CLAUDE.md:905; .env.template:514). Payload: event name, anonymous_id (.anon_id above the package dir), persistent_id (~/.cognee/.persistent_id, survives forget(everything=True)), user_id, tenant_id, and api_key_tracking_id = PBKDF2 of LLM_API_KEY with a public default salt (utils.py:59-122,297-326). Only keys url, session_id, session_ids, datasets are hashed (utils.py:134); dataset_name is sent as-is by remember and forget events (cognee/api/v1/remember/remember.py:1275-1282; cognee/api/v1/forget/forget.py:92-102). Query text and system prompts go as lengths only (cognee/api/v1/search/routers/get_search_router.py:246-258). Events cover API calls, pipeline/task runs, search, remember/recall/forget/export, API exceptions and GLiNER installs (cognee/api/exception_telemetry.py:1-28; cognee/modules/cognify/config.py:139-141); 89 matches of send_telemetry( in 36 non-test files. Maintainers aggregate events daily from a MotherDuck warehouse (.github/workflows/telemetry-insights.yml:1-18). CI disables it except one job (release_test.yml:125-128). UI analytics are no-op stubs (cognee-frontend/src/modules/analytics/index.ts:1-5). OpenTelemetry/Langfuse export is opt-in (cognee/base_config.py:100-148). NETWORK/ACCOUNTS: none required for local use. With LLM_API_KEY set, LLM and embeddings default to OpenAI (README.md:150; .env.template:18-25). Keyless mode downloads models on first use (GLiNER about 750 MB, fastembed bge-small 67 MB; CLAUDE.md:844; cognee/infrastructure/databases/vector/embeddings/config.py:22-29) and runs pip/uv install of gliner2 and CPU torch from download.pytorch.org unless GLINER_AUTO_INSTALL=false (cognee/modules/cognify/config.py:34-35). cognee-cli -ui downloads frontend source from a GitHub tag zip and pulls docker image cognee/cognee-mcp:main (cognee/api/v1/ui/ui.py:184-197,647-652). Ladybug JSON extension is bundled with a remote fallback to extension.ladybugdb.com (cognee_db_workers/ladybug_extensions/README.md:3-16). Cognee Cloud is optional via serve/push (cognee/cli/commands/serve_command.py:27). Search queries/results are logged to the local DB by default (cognee/modules/search/operations/log_query.py:8); logs go to ~/.cognee/logs (cognee/base_config.py:27).

code.architecture: Layered package cognee/: API (cognee/api/client.py + cognee/api/v1/*/routers) -> memory API (cognee/api/v1/{remember,recall,improve,forget}) over add/cognify/search/memify -> pipeline runner cognee/modules/pipelines/ -> tasks cognee/tasks/ -> domain modules cognee/modules/ (graph, retrieval/search, improve with 9 ordered stages, session_lifecycle, provenance, migration (COGX export/import), migrations, users/permissions, agents, integrations, observability) -> adapters cognee/infrastructure/ (relational SQLAlchemy/Alembic; graph Ladybug/Neo4j/Neptune/Postgres-demo; vector LanceDB/PGVector/Turso; session cache sqlite/postgres/redis/fs/tapes; LLM gateway on litellm). Per-user+dataset isolated databases when ENABLE_BACKEND_ACCESS_CONTROL (default true). cognee-mcp/ is a separate FastMCP package (in-process, via --api-url, or Cloud). cognee-frontend/ is the Next.js UI. Also cognee/eval_framework/, deployment/helm, distributed/deploy, catalog/. Optional agent mode makes the API exit when no agent connections remain (cognee/modules/agents/agent_mode.py:1-18).
code.packaging_and_release: PyPI cognee: hatchling==1.32.0, pure-Python py3-none-any wheel plus sdist, packages cognee, cognee_db_workers, kuzu shim, bundled Ladybug JSON extension binaries (pyproject.toml:258-291; docs/supply_chain_provenance.md:94). Separate PyPI cognee-mcp (own version, tags cognee-mcp-v*) via release_mcp.yml, manual, main only (release_mcp.yml:16-17,61-81). release.yml is workflow_dispatch only: tags v<version>, GitHub Release with LLM-written notes, uv build, SLSA provenance attestation, PyPI Trusted Publishing with PEP 740 attestations, then uploads wheel, sdist, .sigstore.json and .intoto.jsonl to the release (release.yml:2-3,11-188). No standalone checksum file; verify with gh attestation verify or PyPI provenance (docs/supply_chain_provenance.md:76-110). Docker Hub cognee/cognee, cognee-ui, cognee-mcp for linux/amd64+arm64 with provenance mode=max and SBOM on release builds (release.yml:190-279,381-468); moving :main/:latest/main-<sha> tags come from dockerhub.yml without those options (dockerhub.yml:3-6,28-48). Weekly dev canaries .devYYYYMMDD (dev_canary_release.yml:3-7,56-57). Base images digest-pinned (Dockerfile:11,19,94); Dependabot covers Actions and Docker only (.github/dependabot.yml:1-6); uv exclude-newer 2 days (pyproject.toml:293-298).

risks: Telemetry is on by default and the README does not mention it. A persistent machine ID (~/.cognee/.persistent_id, kept across forget(everything=True)), user/tenant IDs and a key-derived ID go to https://test.prometh.ai unless TELEMETRY_DISABLED or ENV=test|dev is set (cognee/shared/utils.py:21,94-122,297-326,364-449). The sanitizer hashes only url/session_id/session_ids/datasets (utils.py:134), so dataset_name leaves in clear in remember and forget events (cognee/api/v1/remember/remember.py:1275-1282; cognee/api/v1/forget/forget.py:92-102); MCP default dataset names look like claude_code_memory (cognee-mcp/README.md:589-593).

The Claude Code and Codex integrations the README leads with are not in this repo, so capture hooks, deletion and recovery behavior are unverified here (README.md:218-230). In-repo docs disagree on plugin id and mode (weekly-ticket-proposals.yml:101-104; catalog/entries/integrations/codex.yaml:10-20), and the Claude Code catalog entry says local mode needs LLM_API_KEY and bootstraps a local cognee API (claude-code.yaml:12-16).

Sharing one memory between two agents needs a single process owning the embedded stores plus explicit scoping. Default stores are file-based; Ladybug holds an exclusive file lock in a worker, and the code says API delegation ensures a single process owns all file-based database connections (cognee/cli/api_dispatch.py:1-6; cognee/infrastructure/databases/graph/get_graph_engine.py:84-97). An MCP server without --api-url opens its own databases and sees a different, empty brain (examples/demos/company_brain/multi_source/README.md:161-164). MCP defaults each client to its own dataset (cognee-mcp/README.md:589-601); datasets made by a plugin sub-user are granted to that agent and its parent user only (cognee/modules/data/methods/create_authorized_dataset.py:21-23,39-53); with access control off all datasets share one graph and GRAPH_COMPLETION can cross datasets (cognee-mcp/README.md:603-609).

Learning features are LLM-gated and default to a hosted provider. With LLM_API_KEY set, LLM and embeddings default to OpenAI (README.md:150; .env.template:18-25); default recall routes to HYBRID_COMPLETION (an LLM call) and AUTO_FEEDBACK adds one LLM call per answered session turn (cognee/api/v1/recall/query_router.py:25; cognee/infrastructure/databases/cache/config.py:38-40,55). Keyless mode uses a GLiNER extractor the project calls a demo of an enterprise product, auto-runs pip installs from download.pytorch.org and downloads models at first use (cognee/modules/cognify/config.py:34-35,60-72). Adding an LLM key later flips the default embedder from fastembed to openai/text-embedding-3-large unless pinned (cognee/infrastructure/databases/vector/embeddings/config.py:19-29,203-224), and vectors from different embedding models are not comparable (.agents/skills/cognee-integrations/SKILL.md:65-73).

Deletion is permanent and sometimes unconfirmed; no backup/restore feature was found. cognee-cli forget has no confirmation and MCP forget(everything=True) wipes all owned data (CLAUDE.md:109; cognee-mcp/src/server.py:631-701); forget deletes relational, graph, vector and linked session data with no undo (cognee/api/v1/forget/forget.py:191-366). Recovery options are forget(memory_only=True) plus re-cognify, SDK-only COGX/JSON/GraphML/Cypher export (cognee/api/v1/export/export.py:12-69), CLI graph JSON export (cognee/cli/commands/datasets_command.py:53-55), HTTP markdown export (cognee/api/v1/activity/routers/get_activity_router.py:418-419) and stale-run recovery at startup (cognee/api/client.py:136-138). The hash-chained audit ledger is off by default (cognee/modules/cognify/config.py:20-22); session memory is a cache with a 7-day sliding TTL (cognee/infrastructure/databases/cache/config.py:67).

Durability of the default embedded storage. Ladybug had storage-corruption defects fixed in 0.18.2/0.19.1; macOS 13/14 stay on 0.17.x and remain exposed, and 0.19.1 segfaulted the DB worker in CI so 0.19.0 is pinned (pyproject.toml:80-98). A SIGTERM during a WAL write can leave a corrupted WAL on next start (cognee/api/client.py:169-186). A 100k-node graph cannot be written within the 300 s worker call limit on the file-based backend (.github/workflows/performance_report.yml:53-57). Default data roots resolve inside the cognee package directory (cognee/base_config.py:24-25; cognee/root_dir.py:3; CLAUDE.md:337), and a .env in the working directory or parents overrides shell env (cognee/shared/env_file.py:6,122), so location and provider config can vary by launch directory unless DATA_ROOT_DIRECTORY, SYSTEM_ROOT_DIRECTORY or COGNEE_ENV_FILE are set.

Network and auth defaults. The API binds 0.0.0.0 (cognee/api/client.py:487,537; entrypoint.sh:13); the README docker run publishes port 8000 with authentication off (README.md:258-265; cognee/modules/users/methods/get_authenticated_user.py:15-67). docker-compose.yml defaults CORS to *, a well-known default password, publishes debugger port 5678, runs gunicorn --reload via ENV=local, and starts RedisInsight:latest without a profile (docker-compose.yml:25,39,48,52-54,235-243; entrypoint.sh:54-60). API keys are stored in plaintext unless HASH_API_KEY=true (cognee/modules/users/api_key/hash_api_key.py:4). MCP http/sse bind 127.0.0.1 by default with Host/Origin guards (cognee-mcp/src/server.py:992; cognee-mcp/README.md:262-288).

Supply chain, scope and maintenance. Stable releases carry PEP 740/SLSA attestations and image provenance plus SBOM (release.yml:153-188,219-221), but README-documented moving tags (cognee/cognee:main; cognee/cognee-mcp:main pulled by cognee-cli -ui) come from dockerhub.yml without them (README.md:262; cognee/api/v1/ui/ui.py:647-652; dockerhub.yml:38-48). enola-cli, a prebuilt Go binary with wheels only in uv.lock, is a core dependency (pyproject.toml:112-114; uv.lock:2805-2816); Dependabot skips Python and npm (.github/dependabot.yml:1-6). Open-core: Postgres graph and GLiNER extraction are demos with licensed production versions (README.md:137,281). cognee-mcp has no license metadata, versions independently (0.5.6) and once sat unpublished for about seven weeks (cognee-mcp/pyproject.toml:1-32; release_mcp.yml:4-9). README news shows releases six days apart with a breaking dependency change (README.md:302-304); CODEOWNERS names six handles with one fallback owner (.github/CODEOWNERS:13-70).
